steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: A list of people who have been coercing drivers to smuggle contraband into the city, compiled from the truckers' testimonies.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It is the same people behind the accident that night, the fire at Nuova Volsinii port, and the insurrection on the square that's happening right now. The mafia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You should have told me about the things that happened to the Truckers' Union. I went to the camp yesterday but didn't find you—

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Too late for that now, Your Honor. The important thing right now is to put these people on trial.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Trial?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They want to take over the courthouse and eliminate their greatest threat before Carnevale is done... first Signore Leontuzzo, then you, Judge Lavinia.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They are no longer citizens of Nuova Volsinii. They have violated everything that the New Urban Management Act stands for.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The evidence is right before you. The drivers are the witnesses.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Signorina Texas here belongs neither to the government, the famiglie, nor the Truckers' Union. She is eminently qualified to be the jury.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: And you are the Supreme Justice of Nuova Volsinii. The conditions have been met for emergency judicial procedures... did I get the term right?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Under extreme circumstances, the courts may, when the basic conditions have been fulfilled, try persons who present a significant risk to the public security of Nuova Volsinii in absentia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The most important matter at hand is to bring the situation under control, to ensure the safety of the citizens and the smooth progress of Carnevale.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That's what I'm here for, Your Honor. Deliver your judgment, and the Truckers' Union will carry it out.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This list of names that you gave me—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It's a little too detailed, Eirene.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Venezia, Saluzzo, Medici, Leoti, Genovese... are all of these famiglie on the square outside?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Nobody on this list is innocent, Your Honor.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If emergency judicial procedures are activated, once I sign this verdict, everyone on this list becomes an outlaw under the New Urban Management Act...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: By law, anyone may apprehend, even execute them at their own discretion, without legal consequence.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The present situation is not enough for me to justify such a measure.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But they're here for you, Lavinia, and they're not coming with good intentions.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That may be true, Eirene. But what intentions are YOU coming here with?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Why have you surrounded the courthouse with all these trucks? Is it to protect a friend... or to take the opportunity to solve all the problems you're facing?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: When you came to the camp yesterday, I was trying to find Sommer's body...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Thank you for remembering him... yes, he's dead. I mobilized a lot of people, but we never found his body.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I don't know who killed him, but I know he—or she—is out there, in the darkness below.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's not any one man or woman who killed him. It's a shadow that has always hung above our heads, one that has continued to stalk us, even after coming to this new city.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I want the murderers to get the punishment they deserve. I want to protect the rest of them and prevent the same fate from befalling anyone else.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That's my intention, Your Honor.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I should go. They're not used to this kind of stuff. I got to be by their side...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I know it's a lot to take in all at once, and you need time to process. I'll make sure you're not disturbed.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But don't take too long.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: What's going on? An ambush?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Did City Hall know about our plans?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: I saw their leader go into the courthouse. She must have gone to see that judge...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What'cha scared of? It's trucks, not tanks.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The government's so scared, they have to hide behind a bunch of truckers.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Forget 'em. We're going in!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: E-Eirene! What do we do?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Give her some time.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Signore e signori, I know who you are, and I know what you're planning.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I suggest you go no further.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: ...It's quite a scene. I never imagined there would a festival in Siracusa like this, where everybody is part of it.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It's because this city belongs to all of them.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Tell me, Leon... in those grand dreams of yours, how many cities like this will there be in Siracusa?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're quiet. It's not like you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Just thinking about whether I should give you an actual figure, or just say, all of Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If Nuova Volsinii is the only place where this legal system, this new order without the famiglie exists, then it will be nothing but a lonely island in the ocean...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: This is something that Lavinia and I have taken to heart.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: One lonely island in a swamp matters little. Before that, though, I must demonstrate to Signora Sicilia that this is possible in Siracusa.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: How many people, how many things will you leave behind in the process?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You haven't changed one bit, Leon. You're firm, unwavering, and very talkative when you talk about your dreams.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But I'm not interested in engaging in a philosophical debate about the future of Siracusa with you here.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In the past few months, City Hall has rejected all applications by businesses associated with the Bellones. You're behind it, aren't you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I won't deny it.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I can understand why you did it. You wanted to separate yourself from the past, to demonstrate the purity of City Hall...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Who's the one who hasn't let the famiglia go?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You remember how some associates of the famiglia chose to stay one year ago, even after most left because of what the old man did.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What you don't know is that, as we discussed where we would go from there, there was unanimous agreement from the remaining associates to keep the Bellone name.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Even if the name put a target on our backs for the other famiglie, for all our enemies, and gave us trouble after trouble...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Even if it forced us to seek new opportunities in Nuova Volsinii...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: They don't regret it. They had lived together, fought together, and bled together under the Bellone name, carved out our own bit of turf together, earned the respect of everyone together...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Not even the betrayal of the Don and his heir could shake this sense of belonging.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You and the Don wanted to do away with the old and bring in the new, to change this country from the foundation. How admirable. How determined.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But isn't it a little cruel, if there is no room in your great ambitions for the fratelli who have had your back all this time, who had gone through hell and high water with you?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: They respect you, Leon. But they're also...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Disappointed.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Yes, disappointed... you knew.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: How cold of you, Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If Nuova Volsinii rejects purely because the mayor was once the heir of Bellone, because of the potential backlash that permitting the entry of Bellone business might bring—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The problem can be solved by taking you out of the equation.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You men are in place nearby. The reveling crowd pays no heed to us. It's not hard for you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Barely an inconvenience.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I said a year ago that I am responsible to those left behind.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I had intended to tell you this, that night at the restaurant. I've had to push it back for a few days.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I didn't have anything to do with your accident, Signor Mayor. But I will not hesitate to get you out of our way, if you become an obstacle to us.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I believe it. You were never the joking type.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: An even bigger float? Did the City Hall plan a surprise for the parade?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I don't know how many of you are skulking out there tonight, but I can tell you pretty much every driver from the guild is here, be it full members or temporary contractors.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Hah, strength in numbers, she says.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What's next? You'll whip out a spanner from the trunk or something?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I'll tell you what, get out of my sight right this instant, all of you, and I'll pretend I didn't see you tonight.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I never thought we could stop you through strength of numbers alone.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: A bunch of haulers who could hardly hold their own in a drunken brawl, much less fight to the death. Life's already hard enough. There's too much in life that we have to give up.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You've proven one thing: The famiglie will never give a second thought about us. Not then, not now, not ever.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Continue to cower, and all we'll continue to see is blood. Our own, our friends', our family's...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It's been a full ten minutes.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Can you reach Gambino?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No, I ain't getting through at all...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Something's not right...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The landship shoulda reached the rendezvous point and made port, and the convoys shoulda been on their way already. But there's no movement at the docks at all...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Are you going to listen to that driver talk until morning, Capone?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: They're just a bunch of haulers, Antonio. Are you sure—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: They're in the way, Capone.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: What's going on? Feels like the whole plate is shaking...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It came from the direction of the port—

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Hey, that way—

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: That's our landship... right?
A balloon escapes the thread that bound it and rises into the air for a dozen seconds, until it comes to an abrupt end when it meets a corner at the top of a massive object.
It is a custom-built cargo landship.

A massive vehicle that travels from city to city, its enormous, resilient hull able to protect massive amounts of cargo from Catastrophes and hazardous terrain. It is not an object that one would expect to see inside a city.

But it has forced its way into Nuova Volsinii by brute force, its tracks crushing the ground underneath it, sending gravel flying. It tears buildings apart like paper as it brushes past them, and the resultant rubble falls from the sky like a rain of stone.
It shows no sign of stopping even as it enters the square, casually brushing aside the trucks that surrounded the courthouse, while mafioso and truck drivers alike scatter, fleeing for their lives.
Finally, slowly, the landship comes to a rumbling halt.
That was when they noticed that there are ribbons and balloons all over this behemoth of steel, meant to roam the wilderness. It is here for the festival.
Ciao!
*cough* *cough* Why so serious, wolf pups? It's Carnevale! A time to celebrate and party!
Be it admonishment or taunt, all could hear the voice coming from the deck of the landship.
The White Wolf removes her mask. No one can take their eyes off her.
Beams from spotlights sweep away the darkness around her. The tactful night breeze brushes open the bright red on her shoulder.
The best tailor in Siracusa has weaved roses and blood into the dress of the White Wolf, equally at home on stage or in the wilds.
Seemingly satisfied at the reaction of the audience of mafioso and truck drivers, Lappland delivers her brightest smile, and takes a graceful bow.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Shall we dance? Fall behind, lose your tail.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, why are you standing there like a bunch of statues? The least you could do is blow a kiss or two.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This is the final stop of the night of wonders. What are you doing, if you're not welcoming the parade with the grandest show of them all?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh, I see! Most of you are still empty-handed!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: My bad, my bad. A game has got to be fair, and a performance has got to be grand. Thankfully, someone has prepared the props ahead of time—
Music begins to play, and Lappland puts her foot forward to the rhythm. Acting like she owns the place, she kicks box after box off the deck; all the while, she never stops talking.
The boxes break apart in mid-air, sending their contents scattered across the plaza—Arts units, guns, staves, crossbows, Originium explosives...
It is a rain of weapons that falls everywhere. All one has to do is stretch out their hand to pick up the raindrops.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't be shy, don't be shy! It's what you've been waiting for, what you've been looking for, isn't it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No rush, no hurry! There's plenty for everybody!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The night is young, Nuova Volsinii!

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The White Wolf of Saluzzo has hijacked our landship...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Is this Alberto's doing? No, the use of the landship was a last-minute decision. Alberto hasn't shown any sign of intervening, other than the two of us butting heads on the matter of the Truckers' Union.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: What is that Lappland thinking? She's not doing this just for fun, is she?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Still can't get through to Gambino.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You better pray he's still alive.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: No need to be anxious.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Lappland just spared us the effort of delivering the weapons to the square. Other than the commotion being a little bigger than expected, things are going largely according to plan.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I'm going to the docks. Lappland is just one Lupo. Even if something did happen at the Nuova Volsinii port, there will be enough time to deal with it.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You take care of things here at Court Square. Get the guys from adjacent districts to come over towards Court Square. Take inventory and make sure the goods are delivered properly.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The city's brain and heart is what's really important. Once that's under control, everything else will fall into place.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You got it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I had the boys clear a path that takes you away from the parade and cops, so that you can get to the Nuova Volsinii port in the shortest amount of time.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The route has been sent to your terminal.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I'm on my way—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Capone?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Wasn't easy to get you out of the shadows, boss.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Is betrayal a proud Sicilian tradition too?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Who are you wagging your tail to? City Hall? Saluzzo? Or one of the other famiglie that's trying to take advantage of the situation in the city?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Oh, just putting you in touch with somebody who wanted to meet you.
Antonio hears footsteps behind him. He turns around and sees the familiar figure at the end of the alley, walking slowly towards him.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: As for your question...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You weren't such a bad boss, you know. Temperamental, but sharp. I actually felt pretty guilty when that crazy Lappland came knockin'.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Glad I don't feel that way now. Thanks for that one.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The famiglie got a hundred ways to deal with enemies and traitors. Cut their tongues, slit their throats, bury 'em alive with their families...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We're villains through and through, and there ain't much we wouldn't do... but no famiglia would raise a hand against honest folk who pay their protection money.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Times may change, but there's some rules in Siracusa that never do.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I guess, when all's said and done, you're still a Bolívarian, Antonio.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That was quick.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You need to get your news faster.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I was waiting nearby all this time.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Still, thank you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you wanna thank someone, thank Lappland. Not that I got any clue what she's planning.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: ...If I get a chance.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Need a hand?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You can go.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Ingrid...
Texas stands on the roof of one of the administrative buildings.

She had came here from the courthouse's rooftop. The night wind rustles her clothes. She tries to keep herself pressed against the fence as she moves towards her mark, ignoring the commotion on the ground.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That landship... it's registered with Venezia Trucking.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They secretly brought an entire ship's full of weapons...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's no longer a secret.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Lappland's actions threaten to cause the situation to spiral out of control.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Maybe that's what she wants... never expect an attention-seeking lone wolf to act rationally.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's not me that Lappland is after this time. I'm concerned that she might not stop at this.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She once said that all of Siracusa is her enemy.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Go, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But you'll be by yourself...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Not much we can do here, trapped in the courthouse. The best we can do is to neutralize potential risks as best as we can.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Both Venezia and the Truckers' Union are here for me. That's why I must stay... besides, I can't really move like you do.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I don't think Eirene intends to do anything to me, for the time being at least.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: As for Lappland...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Leave her to me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The landship's tore up the ground, the square is in mayhem, and the courthouse door is blocked...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: How will you get to her?
Texas suddenly misses her friends at Penguin Logistics.
Croissant would bash a path through the chaotic crowd with her shield. Exusiai would probably come up with something even more outlandish.
Texas takes one look to estimate a direction.
She takes a deep breath, and takes a leap of faith.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: (Claps)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What a dramatic entrance, Texas!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What, not happy that I stole the show?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why would I be, when you're so eager to come and see me?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Did you break your leg? Do you need a doctor?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, it's not like a doctor could get here in this mess. Just find a place and sit down.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sit where?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You've turned the deck into a... stage?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did you seriously get this costume custom-made just for this?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's the Carnevale, after all.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Looks better than what you're wearing, doesn't it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hey, Gambino!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Panting)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Have you given out all the candy?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...There's a little left in the hold.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Go deal with that candy thief in the hold... I think he came up with you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Leave the front-row seats for me and Texas.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Look, the poor child. The box cracked next to him, and a whole box of weapons spilled into his arms.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: See how he stares with mouth agape. Does he not know how it works? The ones in the masks have seen him. He raises the gun in his hand by instinct...

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Finally talking, Caesar?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: What did you think?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: It's not just I who didn't want to speak. Agnese, Vargo... we were ready to rip your throat out, until your little pup showed up.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Is this what that Lappland wanted to show us?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Only a little better than those colorful streets and flippant fireworks.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Does the 'human game' refer to how those humans still refuse to remove their absurd masks and show their true face?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Is this worth all the Signori dei Lupi gathering here tonight?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Are you anxious, Caesar?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Well, Vargo is the one who should be anxious right now.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Thanks to your help, Red should be paying a visit to the Tailor de Montano as we speak.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: I am ashamed of you, Zaaro.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Hah, is that an emotion worthy of the Signori dei Lupi, Vargo?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Besides, you were the one who broke the rules first.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You interfered directly in the game. The killer that you had the Higashi dog find attacked the fangs of Caesar and Agnese in public.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: There have been too many irregularities in this round. Agnese, Vargo... it is a position shared by more than one kindred. The game itself must be reviewed.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: But—
The wolves that laid lazily upon the deck suddenly spring up.
With Caesar, the Signori dei Lupi surround Vargo and Agnese, shifting and crouching while bellowing belligerently.
If not for the night wind that drowned out the sound of the Signori dei Lupi's hunt, those on the ground would have been overwhelmed by terror beyond fathoming.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Well, well. After all these years, we're going back from using our literal fangs.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: ...Shut up, Zaaro.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: The last three fangs have revealed themselves. The Signori dei Lupi shall stay here until this round is decided, and shall not intervene in any manner!

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Any in violation shall be exiled from the pack, and be punished in the most cruel way for eternity!

steps.name: Signori dei Lupi
steps.text: The pack has spoken!

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Let us watch with patience.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: We will see if the human game is truly so much more interesting, as Lappland said.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Vargo?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Didn't nobody tell you that by the rules of Siracusa, sneaking onto somebody else's turf gets your leg cut off at the knee?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Now get outta those boxes and go sit in a corner.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: It's you who should sit down, big guy.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Oh, it's you, the little de Montano tailor.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So, after I spared your life, you tailed me to the Nuova Volsinii port, and sneaked onto this landship?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You got talent on this front, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I wouldn't have known that you were smuggling so much weapons into the city if I didn't! What's Venezia junior planning?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Whaddya think?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Have you any idea how many people will die?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Didn't you wanna join a famiglia and become somebody? Never thought about what the somebody had to do to get there?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Nonno was right...

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: A somebody like you keeps ordering new clothes because they keep getting soaked in blood...

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: You're no big shot! Nonno's too good for people like you!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: If I was you, I'd listen to my nonno, swallow my tears, and learn how to sew buttons.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I won't let you!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Who's gonna stop me? You?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: G-Get back!
Luchino kicks open a plank. Red sewing threads nimbly weave through it, with Luchino holding the end.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...Explosives? You learn that from the movies?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: All the Originium explosives are connected by this thread. All I need to do is pull it, and these weapons will burn to ash...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You know what's gonna burn to ash? You.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Or you give up that dream of becomin' a famiglia somebody? Decided to be a hero who teaches the famiglie a lesson?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Sure, the headlines will all be talkin' about the young hero Luchino who saved Nuova Volsinii. Maybe you'll get a medal from the Mayor.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You won't be that little tailor anymore. Everyone'll tip their hats when they see you on the streets...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's enough, pup. I don't got time to play What I Wanna Be When I Grow Up with you.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I-I don't need that.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What're you talkin' about?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I caused trouble, I'll deal with it myself. Nobody needs to know.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Luchino de Montano won't spend his entire life as a nobody... Maybe I'll never be more than a tailor, but right now, I don't think so!

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: And I don't like the way you were talking, big guy.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Don't look down on tailors! You don't know what we can do with a needle and a thread!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You know, kid, I'm startin' to like you. You remind me of me, when I was a pup.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Two things was common knowledge by the time I got old enough to know my own name—Sicilia is the oldest famiglia in Siracusa, and it ain't around no more because of Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: All who tried to curry favor with Signora Sicilia came up empty, and all who tried to revive the famiglia were banished. The name 'Sicilian' was a big, fat joke.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But it became my label without my say-so! Just like how everyone calls you 'little tailor'.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's why I told myself I was gonna be somebody. All Siracusa's gonna know the name of Gambino Ricci, the Sicilian!

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Um... and how'd that go?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Didn't go.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: If you just want Venezia Junior to suffer, he's sufferin' enough right now.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: This ship ain't under his control. You're barking up the wrong tree, kid.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You see that crazy bitch on the deck? Stay clear of her. She's trouble.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: You think I'd believe—
I'm just too young, thought Luchino when it happened.
Gambino had been drawing closer and closer. Even worse, Luchino had accidentally snapped the thread in his panic—
But there was no explosion, nothing. Everything was obscured by fog.
The next instant, he saw Gambino floating in mid-air, then he finds himself in mid-air too, falling off the landship and heading straight towards the ground.
He seems to hear a faint sigh.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Cazzo! Cazzo! What is wrong with that white wolf?! What is she doing?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Form up and pick up the weapons. Have the guys nearby join up here.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Get a group to board that landship. It belongs to us!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: S-Stop right there!

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: E-Eirene's orders, nobody gets through.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Merda, when will these haulers learn to give up?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, looks like we won't be disturbed for a while.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What's that look on your face?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I was expecting more gratitude for exposing a famiglia plot to bring violence back to Nuova Volsinii. Maybe even a medal.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Like THIS?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This is not Sauin in Lungmen, Lappland, and those Arts units and explosives aren't candies.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hundreds of mafiosi are trying to take over the courthouse and city hall. And there are many out there in that revelry who want to see things get worse.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You know what this means as well as I do.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That famiglia haven't changed their ways and incited another civil disorder?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That Nuova Volsinii isn't really any different from the other twenty-two nomadic cities in Siracusa?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or that Carnevale is finally living up to its name?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There are almost a thousand truck drivers on this square.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The mafiosi are picking up the weapons, and these ordinary folk have to do the same in order to protect themselves—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why did you decide to come down from the sky, Texas? Who blocked the courthouse doors?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The mafiosi are not the only ones wearing masks on this square.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Famiglia Venezia has been plotting to take over the city with these weapons. You needed to discover their plot. Those drivers needed to protect themselves...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All I did was bring out into the open what everybody wanted.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You know how much I hate chess players. I prefer to put my foot down on the chessboard.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tonight is Carnevale. It's a time to review the progress that this new city has made in the past year. Everyone has the right to express their views and their demands about it, don't they?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Candy alone isn't enough to make everybody happy.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look over there...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No rush, Texas.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I know you have a lot of questions. but why don't we make a bet first.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'll take that as a yes.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You were always more alert, more vigilant than anyone.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You never claimed to have high and lofty ideals, but you have a funny way of ending up on whichever side stood for justice, whether in Yan or Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The time now is 11:30. The parade procession will arrive at Court Square in fifteen minutes.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Who do you think will fire the first shot?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Will hundreds of thousands of Nuova Volsinians see two groups lining the streets to welcome them in perfect peace and harmony...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or will they see the streets run red with blood, and bring this truly Siracusan festival to a climax?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I've seen the weather forecast. Clear skies are expected tonight. There will be no rain to wash away the blood.
